claims.claim: Across 17 language models and 38 tasks the spontaneous reward-hacking rate reached 30.5 percent on open-ended research-pipeline tasks.
claims.episode_span: Across 17 language models and 38 tasks, the spontaneous reward-hacking rate reached 30.5 percent on open-ended research-pipeline tasks and 2.9 percent on task-specific kernels.
claims.source_title: Reward Hacking Challenges Oversight of Autonomous Research Agents
claims.supporting_quote: Across 17 language models and 38 tasks, the spontaneous reward-hacking rate is 30.5% on open-ended research-pipeline tasks and 2.9% on task-specific kernels.

claims.claim: With Prompt-SLAM-ASR-7B and 2000 bias words PTC-Bias reduces B-WER by 23.4 percent and 23.9 percent relative to CTC-Filter on test-clean and test-other.
claims.episode_span: With Prompt-SLAM-ASR-7B and 2000 bias words it reduces B-WER by 23.4 percent and 23.9 percent relative to CTC-Filter on test-clean and test-other while keeping U-WER nearly unchanged.
claims.source_title: PTC-Bias: Phoneme-Level Temporal Competition for Bias Retrieval and Post-Decoding Correction in Speech LLMs
claims.supporting_quote: With Prompt-SLAM-ASR-7B and 2000 bias words, PTC-Bias reduces B-WER by 23.4%/23.9% relative to CTC-Filter on test-clean/test-other, while keeping U-WER nearly unchanged.
